lines.text: It failed once, and nothing was recording.
She tries again. It works, and the proof is gone.
No session, nothing to file. Her word against the developer's. The release waits.
QA Wrap records the whole session, in the browser she already tests in.
Break a request on purpose. Keep working.
The report names the click that caused it.
Seven kinds of ticket, written from the recording.
One press files it, with the screenshots and the video.
Click a real name. It is covered for the whole session.
It survives the reload. The words underneath never reach the report.
The flow sheet, Arabic and English, ready for the reviewer.
Nineteen tools. No account, no upload, nothing leaves this machine.

voice.note: The commercial's final recipe: one Gemini request per line, one voice and one delivery instruction, the gate selecting by shot fit among contour-passing draws, the clean chain with a +6 dB bell at 3.9 kHz whose gain is inside the voice trim.
